mini.fire_verify.goal.en: Find the cells that pass the line in both images
mini.fire_verify.goal.zh-TW: 找出兩張圖都過線的格子

mini.fire_verify.hint.en: Both images past the line means real fire

mini.fire_verify.link.en: A hot spot in one channel can be sun-baked desert or sun glint. Check a second channel: only when both rise is it a real fire. False alarms waste firefighters' time and trust.
mini.fire_verify.link.zh-TW: 單一頻道的熱點可能只是沙漠曬熱或太陽反光，要用第二個頻道交叉驗證，兩個都升高才是真火。誤報會浪費消防人力，也會傷害信任。

mini.fire_verify.cap.rule.en: Real fire shows up past the line in both images

mini.fire_verify.cap.fail.en: Too many false alarms or misses
